context.body: The Spirit in the Gospels · Luke 4:31–38
context.label: The Spirit in the Gospels

observations.body: Luke 4:31–38 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon.”
observations.label: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon

payload.posture: Read Luke 4:31–38 as evidence about the Spirit, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states luke 4:31–38 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
